scheme_name: Assistance for Purchase of Safety Equipment (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
other_conditions: The applicant must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
The applicant must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
The applicant must be a registered member of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The applicant must have deposited up-to-date annual contributions for one year to the Board.
benefits_summary: One‑time reimbursement of ₹1,000 for purchase of safety equipment such as helmet, safety shoes, and hand‑gloves.
